panel.description: One of the two file lists side by side (the twin panels).

tab.description: A folder tab on top of a panel, as in a browser.

sidebar.description: The pane on the left with Places, Folders, Connections and Operations.

Places.description: Sidebar section: bookmarks, drives, cloud, devices. Translate as the file manager of the language's desktop does (Dolphin/Nautilus 'Places').

bookmark.description: A saved folder in Places, as browsers' bookmarks.

connection.description: A saved server (SFTP, FTP, WebDAV, …) in the Connections section.

operation.description: A job in the queue: a copy, move, download, packing, checksum…

trash.description: The desktop's trash / recycle bin. Use the platform's usual word.

button bar.description: The F3–F8 function key buttons at the bottom, as Total Commander's.

command line.description: The one-line command entry under the panels.
